description: React component for managing datasets, including listing, searching, pagination, adding, editing, and deleting datasets with API interactions and UI elements.

methods.name: EvalDatasets
methods.description: Main React component for dataset management interface, handling state, API calls, user interactions, and rendering dataset table with controls.

methods.name: onChange
methods.description: Handles pagination change, updates current page and limit, and triggers data refresh.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches dataset data from API based on current page and limit.

methods.name: goToRows
methods.description: Navigates to dataset rows view for selected dataset.

methods.name: onSearchChange
methods.description: Updates search state based on user input.

methods.name: addNew
methods.description: Opens dialog to add a new dataset.

methods.name: edit
methods.description: Opens dialog to edit selected dataset.

methods.name: deleteDataset
methods.description: Confirms and deletes a dataset via API, with snackbar notifications.

methods.name: onConfirm
methods.description: Closes dataset dialog and refreshes data.

methods.name: filterDatasets
methods.description: Filters datasets based on search string.
